title: manager setup · Assign planner to define a bounded research protocol for comparing dyn
summary: Assign planner to define a bounded research protocol for comparing dynamic vs. static agent memory on fixed-token benchmarks, explicitly noting missing baselines.
body: Previous loops failed to find controlled empirical comparisons of dynamic vs. static memory under identical token budgets. The literature lacks the necessary experimental controls for causal claims. This task pivots to gathering descriptive evidence on standard benchmarks (e.g., ScienceWorld, BigBench) under fixed budgets. We must inspect 4 sources that report task success and hallucination rates, explicitly documenting where direct baseline comparisons are absent. This builds the evidence base required for the next phase gate without violating the research-only constraint. Limit to 4 sources; do not implement code.
